suppress.notes: Accepted by Kendar on 2026-11-27: Spring Framework 6.2.19 (spring-aop, spring-core, ...) is the latest 6.2.x and the fixes exist only in Spring Framework 7 (Spring Boot 4), which is a planned migration. Applicability checked in code 2026-11-27: the app uses only annotated Spring MVC controllers + SseEmitter, with no WebFlux, RSocket, XsltView, functional endpoints, Aalto or SpEL, so CVE-2026-47884/85/86/88/89/90/91/92/93 and 59283/59313 do not apply. CVE-2026-59282 (data binding of user-supplied property paths) was NOT assessed. Re-check at expiry or on migration.

Accepted 2026-11-27: httpcore5/httpclient5 are shaded inside docker-java-transport-zerodep, which comes only from Testcontainers (test helper, optional/test scope, never shipped) and cannot be overridden through Maven.
